entries.instructions.use: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: use the item.
entries.instructions.interact: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: interact with supported entities.
entries.instructions.bucket_pickup: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: pick up a water or lava source.
entries.instructions.bucket_place: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: place the contained source.
entries.instructions.plant: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: plant on valid soil.
entries.instructions.bonemeal: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: fertilize a supported crop.
entries.instructions.milk: Left click: attack or mine. Hold right click: drink and clear all status effects.
entries.instructions.food: Left click: attack or mine. Hold right click: consume.
entries.instructions.axe: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: strip a log, scrape copper or remove wax.
entries.instructions.shovel: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: flatten dirt into a path.
entries.instructions.hoe: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: till soil into farmland.
entries.instructions.spear: Left click: fully charged piercing stab. Hold right click: kinetic spear attack.
entries.instructions.potion_drink: Left click: attack or mine. Hold right click: drink.
entries.instructions.potion_throw: Left click: attack or mine. Right click: throw.
